Development notes (build steps, design decisions, release steps and open issues) are kept in a separate private repository: https://github.com/lvlaanderen/DiskLED-notes, file `COPILOT_NOTES.md`.

- Read that file before working on this project. Clone it next to this repository: `git clone https://github.com/lvlaanderen/DiskLED-notes.git ../DiskLED-notes`. If you cannot access it, ask the user.
- After changing something worth remembering, update the notes there and commit and push in that repository. Do not put development notes in this public repository.
- Ask before pushing, merging, tagging or publishing releases.
